hypothesis: Disentangle P26 contradictory-actuator failure: matched-information concurrent context training vs blocked task ordering for same 489-param GRU, vs equally supervised fully trained conventional history MLP and explicit known task-action mapping.

training.index_streams: Two independent Torch generators seed+900001 normal and seed+900002 reverse; independently successive randperm until 311296 examples. All arms share exact streams and sample counts.
training.joint_gru: 489-param original, 1216 updates of 256 normal+256 reverse; explicit cue
training.blocked_gru: same 489-param initialization, 608 old-only updates of 512, then 608 reversed-only updates of 512; exactly same old/new rows in different temporal order
training.joint_mlp: 471-param full history conventional MLP, same 1216 mixed minibatches
training.joint_cue_blind_gru: identical GRU init/mixed indices/labels/updates, explicit context cue overwritten with +1 for both tasks
training.frozen_old_half_GRU_XOR: Take frozen 608-old-only-update blocked GRU and predict physical direction for both tasks, then known 1-action cue mapping externally. No new optimizer steps.
training.conventional_controls: strong two-observation past-only finite-difference with cue; full-public-state teacher

preregistered.order_gain: joint both >=150 and joint reversed >= blocked reversed+25 and joint old >= blocked old-20 in >=2/3 seeds
preregistered.MLP_capacity_warning: MLP both >=150 in >=2 seeds while joint GRU both>=150 in <=1 seed
preregistered.cue_reversal_negative: Inverted cue at evaluation degrades trained joint GRU reversed-world return >=25 in >=2 seeds
preregistered.XOR_old_anchor: Old-only frozen GRU plus known deterministic task action inversion achieves >=175 old and reverse in >=2 seeds
